# A Noble View of Things Counts Against Its Truth[^1]

In this real world of sweat and dirt, when a view of things is 'noble,' that ought to count as a presumption against its truth, and as a philosophic disqualification. The prince of darkness may be a gentleman, as we are told he is, but whatever the God of earth and heaven is, he can surely be no gentleman. His menial services are needed in the dust of our human trials, even more than his dignity is needed in the empyrean.

[^1]: [[@Pragmatism - William James]]
